systems.system: EC-MADA programme: digitisation of civil registration records
systems.platform: Studia Inc OCR models with blind double entry (algorithmic processing plus human validation); D.IA Advisory for integration into existing information systems and interoperability with national platforms
systems.owner: Studia Inc, a vendor, within the national EC-MADA programme
systems.tiers: inventory, digitisation and indexing of nearly 10 million existing civil registration records covering 1,695 communes across 11 priority regions, by autonomous mobile units; 500 people over 7 months (vendor's press release)

note: Back-capture of paper civil registers already written; nothing on how an office records a new birth or death.
